title: CBP-v1 frame
description: Cortico Bridge Protocol v1 single JSON frame over one WebSocket text message. Ten frame types share the common header {v,t,id,ts}. Table generalized from cortico-world-astrbot private frame v1 (repos/world-astrbot@4725feee6 src/driver.ts:522-676, parseFrame rejects null/array/scalar at driver.ts:704-717) per _COMPAT-BLUEPRINT.md G8; fields marked final are drafted by _BUILD-PLAN.md 3.1 (2026-11-15). Each of the ten frame shapes closes its own object with additionalProperties:false; unknown keys make a frame invalid and the kernel must swallow bad frames without throwing (_BUILD-PLAN.md 2.2 frames.ts, blueprint 2.1). The passthrough fields $defs/any (raw, event data), seg.data, and call.args are intentionally open (F18).

turnWindow.description: Retention window for turn records, in seconds. The integer const is the only copy of this number in the fleet. tools/gen_table.py writes it into cbp_table.py as TURN_TTL_SECONDS in both bridge repos. tools/gen_pins.py writes it into spec/pins.json as turn.ttl_seconds. cortico-bridge-core/src/correlate.ts and cortico-world-neko/src/world.ts read that one value through the kernel. A deployment may override the value with the environment variable CORTICO_TURN_TTL_SECONDS. Both sides use the same name. This window is not the dedup window in cortico-bridge-core/src/dedup.ts, and it is not the rid reply cache window in idempotency.ts. It is a protocol constant, not a frame type. It never appears inside a frame.

any.description: Arbitrary JSON value, including null. Used for raw passthrough and event data; content is framework-defined and kept verbatim (blueprint 2.1 meta.raw rule). No type keyword means accept-everything.

ts.description: float64 Unix seconds. Cortico side converts only via new Date(ts*1000).toISOString() (_BUILD-PLAN.md 3.1).

conv.description: Conversation key, opaque to CBP. neko=conversation_id; maibot=stream_id; astrbot=UMO platform:message_type:session_id (message_session.py:18-20 @133dd9f86); v11 session_id form e.g. group_5_4 (r-nonebot-onebot 2.4).

caps.description: Capability name list. Vocabulary = images,buttons,audio_out,files,notices,reply_tail,self_echo,tools,history_backfill (c1-adapters-per-framework 5.5). Unknown names are ignored in the intersection, not an error.

toolName.description: Tool or action name. neko llm_tool pins ^[A-Za-z0-9_.\-]{1,64}$ (llm_tool.py:52-57 @52e973ed2, blueprint 2.2); CBP keeps the length bound and lets each host enforce its own pattern.

toolAnn.description: Tool announcement entry. risk six values are Cortico ToolTag verbatim (repos/cortico@836238311 src/core/types.ts:202, _BUILD-PLAN.md 3.1 G6).

seg.description: Message segment, OneBot v11 shape {type,data} with every value a string (upstream/onebot-11@d4456ee70 message/array.md:23, d-onebot-spec 3.2). at param name is qq (segment.md:167); at_all maps to {type:'at',data:{qq:'all'}} (_BUILD-PLAN.md 3.1). Kernel whitelist plus unknown-type [type] fallback live in segment.ts (C1-16 sole implementation point).

self.description: Account declaration carried by hello and ready (F1/F2, SECURITY-CBP 2). proven:true only from a host-evidenced source (v11 get_login_info user_id, AstrBot event.get_self_id(), MaiBot internal_chat.identity); any configured, operator-typed, or peer-declared value stays proven:false. An empty id is legal and must honestly say proven:false — 「no self」 may not be faked by omission (SECURITY-CBP 2 rule 1). Keys close at three.

anon.description: Anonymity state of the operator behind a call, verbatim from SECURITY-CBP 1 rule 2: member.id equals self id yields self; an anonymous carrier in the payload yields anonymous; no host-proven sender yields unknown; otherwise identified.

actor.description: Operator identity of a call (F3, SECURITY-CBP 1). The bridge fills it from its own inbound record keyed by turn; the wire copy is reconciliation material only — on disagreement the host record wins and the bridge reports degraded reason actor-mismatch. platform is the host's self-named platform string verbatim (AstrBot UMO first segment, MaiBot MessageDict.platform, v11 normalized message_type, neko bus source). Four keys closed; call.args stays open by contrast.

agent.description: Announcing endpoint identity. 60001 disconnect text must carry both sides name/version/sha (_BUILD-PLAN.md 2.2 negotiate.ts; blueprint 2.1).

blob.description: Inbound-reply media body, base64 only. No URL or file handle crosses CBP (U7 in blueprint 6.1); neko external URL images are rejected on the host side (r-neko 5).

error.description: Error object inside reply frames. Codes: v12 baseline 0/10001..10007/20001/20002 (upstream/onebot@d533f0fca specs/action-response.md:43-99, d-onebot-spec 6.1) plus bridge band 60001..60008 (c1 5.4). Passthrough host codes are allowed by integer range.

msg.description: Inbound or bridged conversation message. kind drives the Cortico-side trigger tier: mention/direct to flush, group/other to debounce (_BUILD-PLAN.md 3.2 table). Self echo is detected world-side by sender.id == the self id declared by the bridge's hello/ready with proven:true (F1/F2).

notice.description: Non-message occurrence. Piggyback tier only (blueprint 2.1 envelope rule). kind is the host event discriminator leaf, e.g. group_increase, poke, friend_add.

ack.description: Receipt that a msg/notice frame was taken by the peer. rid targets the acknowledged frame id.

call.description: Tool invocation. rid correlates the future reply. tool must be announced in ready/catalog tools[] (_BUILD-PLAN.md 3.2 peer_call rule; unlisted name gives 60002). turn and actor are required (F3): the bridge fills actor from its inbound record, a self-reported wire actor is reconciliation material only, and a turn with no record is refused with 60004. args stays an open object (SECURITY-CBP 1 rule 4).

turn.description: id of the inbound msg frame that started this turn (SECURITY-CBP 1 rule 2); the bridge resolves identity from its own record keyed by it.

reply.description: Answer to a call, correlated by rid. ok:false must carry error; ok:true may carry text and/or blobs. 30000ms correlation timeout is translated kernel-side to 60007, never silently (_BUILD-PLAN.md 3.2).

event.description: Bridge state push. name connection maps to <w>.connection flush tier, degraded to <w>.degraded (_BUILD-PLAN.md 3.2 table).

tick.description: Application heartbeat. Driver layer only, never reaches host (_BUILD-PLAN.md 3.2 last table row; ping 20s / idle 120s params in driver.ts).

catalog.description: Full current tool directory for drift reconciliation (blueprint G5, graft from c3 7). tools[] replaces the last known directory; empty array means no announced tools.
